title: CRIC Evidence, Provenance and Trust Specification
summary: Defines how CRIC records provenance, evidence classes, trust dimensions, licensing and integrity hashing so every consequential output traverses back to source evidence.
notes: Path sits under docs/CRIC-PRD-v0.1/ (PRD-family directory) and the doc ends with a 'v0.1 Acceptance Criteria' section, both PRD signals. Dominant content signals are implementation contracts: a ProvenanceRecord YAML schema, controlled vocabularies (evidence classes, licence status), a named hash algorithm, and required fields for agent/model provenance and release manifests. H1 self-identifies as 'Specification'. Resolved to SPEC per the ADR > SPEC > PRD > DOC precedence rule. No YAML frontmatter, no markdown links or filename mentions to other docs.
